reported_success.quote: An Unsuccessful Preregistered Replication of the Effect of Product Size on Status Signaling

notes: Both assigned partial-eta-squared records have identical neutral descriptions and locators. No assignment inferred from audit ID or input order. Original PDF p. 5 (web P4), Results and Discussion: interaction F(1,177)=4.06, p=.03, partial eta-squared=.05; status-only size effect F(1,177)=10.22, p=.001, partial eta-squared=.10. Replication p. 3: corresponding interaction F(2,412)=0.83, p=.435, partial eta-squared<0.01; status-only size effect F(2,412)=0.48, p=.620, partial eta-squared=0.002. These are candidate tests, not assigned extracted values. Replication pp. 2-3 reports N=415 and no exclusions. Original Method reports N=183 but does not explicitly establish exclusions/test-specific analytic N; do not derive N from the inconsistent reported degrees of freedom. Original title verified in primary author-hosted PDF; saved web parse is an excerpt of the full PDF.
